target.purpose: Represent lane-topology uncertainty as an explicit engineering state so route selection cannot silently convert unknown map topology into free space.
target.central_bottleneck: Path planning becomes unsafe or misleading when UNKNOWN topology is collapsed into traversable or blocked state without an explicit authority decision.
success: Edges preserve FREE, UNKNOWN, and BLOCKED as distinct states.
Default path search refuses UNKNOWN edges.
Adversarial tests exercise unsafe uncertainty collapse and refusal behavior.
A cold-start operator path reproduces behavior and emits a proof receipt.
The repository remains an independent Waymo-specialist system while reusable uncertainty semantics may be extracted with lineage preserved.

invariants: edge state is one of FREE, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED
UNKNOWN is never treated as FREE by default
proof and promotion claims remain bound to repository-native evidence
company-specific identity is preserved when reusable capability is extracted

donor_plan.basis: The current Go and Python lane-uncertainty mechanisms are repository-owned implementations; no donor implementation is required to define or operate the central mechanism.
donor_plan.future_extraction: Reusable uncertainty-state semantics may be contributed upward only with source lineage, proof equivalence, and preservation of this repository's independent identity.

nonclaims: reference engineering system, not a production autonomous-driving deployment
local promotion authority is not external employer or production authority
